title: migrations 1156/1157: '-- Scope:' (uppercase S) silently misclassified by case-sensitive migrationScope parser
scope: src/db/migrations.zig (case-sensitive -- scope: header matcher) and two migration files with uppercase headers.
description: Mirror of GH-703 (to be filed). migrationScope() in src/db/migrations.zig uses std.mem.indexOf(u8, header, '-- scope: ...') (case-sensitive) to classify each migration. Two PRM-batch files were authored with '-- Scope:' (capital S), so they fall through to the default .all_schemas and apply to tenant_default. Their bodies then ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN tenant_id, which fails on the tenant-side table because tenant tables lack tenant_id under SPT architecture. Result: all 27 PLC tests fail at the migration harness with: [MIGRATION_DEBUG] simpleQuery failed: err=QueryFailed schema=tenant_default file=1157_prm09_solution_pack_update.sql Underlying psql error: column 'tenant_id' does not exist.
symptom: All 27 PLC integration tests fail at the migration harness (commit 5eddb97b) with simpleQuery failed ... column 'tenant_id' does not exist on tenant_default. TEST-RUNNER rework 5 reported the failure.
investigation_notes: Header search is case-sensitive (std.mem.indexOf). Both offending files have '-- Scope:' on line 20. 28 other migration files all use lowercase '-- scope:' — confirmed via grep across migrations/*.sql. The fix is mechanical: change the first character S -> s in both files. No source-code change needed because the parser is documented to expect lowercase (see SCOPE_PUBLIC_HEADER constants and the docstring at src/db/migrations.zig:52, 622). Verified post-fix by running zig build migrate against BPM_TEST_DB_URL: 'No new migrations to apply.' with no simpleQuery failed errors. 1156 and 1157 now correctly skip with the right scope.

No new source-code change was needed during WF-03 — the verification confirms the existing fix. `test-env-verify` is CLEARED (C0–C9 all PASS) per the ADHOC-test-env-stale-locks-20260815-00-backend-dev infrastructure repair earlier the same day. actions: Add a regression test to `zig build test-env-verify` (or a dedicated C10 'scope-header-case' check) that asserts `grep -rn '^-- Scope:' migrations/` returns 0; any uppercase match fails the env-verify gate before migrations ever run.

Either (a) add a lint rule in `tools/lint_migrations.py` to enforce `^-- scope:` (all lowercase) on the scope header of every `migrations/*.sql`, reporting BLOCKER for any uppercase match; or (b) make `src/db/migrations.zig:migrationScope()` case-insensitive — `std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase` over the `'-- scope:'` token — so future authoring drift is harmless. Option (b) is the smallest diff and removes the class of bug entirely; option (a) is preferable if header canonicalisation is to remain strict.
